format: See tools/bench/README.md. Turn decisions: the board has four cards and there is no river script. Ranges are assumed, not solved: each is the player's range at the hero's turn decision.

spots.description: BTN opens 2.5bb, BB calls (single-raised pot); dry board, flop checked through; hero OOP first to act. Flop checked through; BB keeps nearly its whole defend range (some sets and Kx check-raised). BTN, which c-bets this flop with most hands, checked back weak pairs, high cards, the turned diamond and straight draws, and a few traps.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:F BTN:R50 SB:F BB:C

spots.description: BTN opens 2.5bb, BB calls (single-raised pot); wet board, flop bet-call; hero IP facing a 50% turn bet. BB called a small c-bet on a wet flop and leads half pot on the 4c: a merged range of straights, two pair and sets, pairs with draws, and heart and straight draws. BTN c-bet most of its range: overpairs, Jx, Tx, straights, draws and air.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:F BTN:R50 SB:F BB:C

spots.description: BTN opens 2.5bb, BB calls (single-raised pot); paired board, flop checked through; hero IP facing a 75% turn bet. Flop checked through; BB probes the turn jack 75%: polarised between trips, full houses and strong Jx and diamond and straight draws. BTN checked back pairs, high cards and some trips.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:F BTN:R50 SB:F BB:C

spots.description: BTN opens 2.5bb, BB calls (single-raised pot); monotone board, flop bet-call; hero OOP first to act. BB check-called a small c-bet on a monotone flop: Qx, 8x, pairs, some flushes (others check-raised), one-heart draws, the turned set of fives and straight draws. BTN c-bet Qx, overpairs, flushes, heart draws and air.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:F BTN:R50 SB:F BB:C

spots.description: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls (BTN in position); dry board, flop checked through; hero IP facing a 50% turn bet. CO skipped the c-bet on an ace-high flop and bets half pot on the 5d after BTN checked back: weak aces, turned fives and wheel and diamond draws. BTN checked back pairs below the ace, high cards and a few weak aces.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:R50 BTN:C SB:F BB:F

spots.description: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls (BTN in position); wet board, flop bet-call; hero IP facing a 75% turn bet. CO c-bet small, BTN called, and CO barrels 75% on the 2s: overpairs, sets, two pair and straights against diamond and straight draws. BTN called with pairs, straight draws and diamond draws.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:R50 BTN:C SB:F BB:F

spots.description: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls (BTN in position); paired board, flop bet-call; hero OOP first to act. CO c-bet a paired flop small with nearly its whole range and BTN called with queens, pairs, A-high and backdoor draws; the 3d adds a diamond draw. CO is first to act on the turn.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:R50 BTN:C SB:F BB:F

spots.description: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls (BTN in position); monotone board, flop checked through; hero IP facing a 50% turn bet. Monotone flop checked through; CO bets half pot on the Kh: Kx, sets, some slowplayed flushes and spade and straight draws. BTN checked back pairs, high cards, weak flushes and draws.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:R50 BTN:C SB:F BB:F

spots.description: BTN opens 2.5bb, SB 3-bets to 9bb, BTN calls (3-bet pot); dry board, flop checked through; hero IP facing a 75% turn bet. The 3-bettor checked a dry flop, BTN checked back, and SB bets 75% on the 2c: Kx, sets and overpairs against club and wheel draws. BTN checked back pairs, A-high and some Kx.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:F BTN:R50 SB:R180 BB:F BTN:C

spots.description: BTN opens 2.5bb, SB 3-bets to 9bb, BTN calls (3-bet pot); wet board, flop checked through; hero OOP first to act. The 3-bettor checked a wet flop and BTN checked back; the 6s turn makes 8x a straight. SB is first to act with overpairs, A-high, Tx, heart draws and a few sets and straights. BTN checked back medium pairs, A-high and draws.
spots.pre: UTG:F HJ:F CO:F BTN:R50 SB:R180 BB:F BTN:C

spots.description: BTN opens 2.5bb, SB 3-bets to 9bb, BTN calls (3-bet pot); paired board, flop bet-call; hero IP facing a 50% turn bet. SB c-bet the paired flop, BTN called, and SB barrels half pot on the Kc: Kx, overpairs, trips and club draws. BTN called with pairs, A-high, Kx and backdoor draws.
